title: The Second Conditional
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Ya sabes cómo hablar de escenarios hipotéticos e imaginarios usando el Segundo Condicional.

parts.visual:
Usamos el Segundo Condicional para situaciones hipotéticas o imaginarias (que no son reales en el presente). 
Estructura: IF + Past Simple, WOULD + Verbo base. 
Ej: If we had more money, we would hire more people (Si tuviéramos más dinero, contrataríamos más gente).
parts.audio: We use the Second Conditional for hypothetical or imaginary situations that are not real in the present. Structure: IF plus Past Simple, WOULD plus the base verb. Example: If we had more money, we would hire more people.

parts.visual:
Importante: Para el verbo TO BE con 'If', usamos 'WERE' para todas las personas (I, he, she, it). 
Ej: If I were the CEO, I would change the strategy (Si yo fuera el CEO, cambiaría la estrategia).
parts.audio: Important: For the verb TO BE with 'If', we use 'WERE' for all subjects, including I, he, she, and it. Example: If I were the CEO, I would change the strategy.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Completa la oración hipotética con la estructura correcta del Second Conditional.

questions.question: If I ____ more time, I would learn Spanish. (Si tuviera - Pasado de have).
questions.explanation: Después de 'If' usamos Past Simple: had (tuviera).

questions.question: If we launched the product now, we ____ fail. (Fracasaríamos).
If I ____ you, I wouldn't sign that contract. (Si yo fuera).
questions.explanation: En condicionales hipotéticos, usamos 'were' para 'I' (If I were you).

questions.question: They would buy our software if we ____ the price. (Si bajáramos/redujéramos).
If he ____ English, he would get a promotion. (Si hablara - Pasado).
What ____ you do if you were the boss? (¿Qué harías?).
If the company ____ bankrupt, we would lose our jobs. (Si fuera - Go past tense).
questions.explanation: Pasado de go = went (If the company went bankrupt).

questions.question: I ____ quit my job if I won the lottery. (Renunciaría).
If she ____ the answer, she would tell us. (Si supiera).
We would travel more if we ____ more vacations. (Si tuviéramos).
If I ____ the CEO, I would give everyone a bonus. (Si fuera).
questions.explanation: Para situaciones imaginarias usamos 'were' con todas las personas.

questions.question: He ____ be a great manager if he listened to his team. (Él sería).
If we didn't have so many meetings, we ____ be more productive. (Seríamos).
I would accept the offer if they ____ me more money. (Si pagaran).
If you ____ the deadline, the client would be furious. (Si incumplieras).
We ____ accept this proposal. It's too risky. (No aceptaríamos).
If the internet ____ down, we couldn't work. (Si se cayera).
Would you ____ to Paris if they offered you a job there? (¿Te mudarías?).
questions.explanation: Después de 'would', el verbo va en forma base: move.

questions.question: If he ____ a car, he would drive to work. (Si tuviera).
If I were the client, I ____ complain immediately. (Me quejaría).

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en Past Simple o el auxiliar 'would' según corresponda.

questions.question: If I ____ more time, I would do it. (Si tuviera - had/have)
If I ____ you, I wouldn't do it. (Si yo fuera - was/were)
We ____ hire him if we had money. (Contrataríamos - will/would)
If he ____ English, he would get the job. (Si hablara - spoke)
What ____ you do if you were the CEO? (¿Qué harías?)
I would leave if they ____ me. (Si me despidieran - fired)
If she ____ the answer, she would tell us. (Si supiera - knew)
I ____ quit my job if I won the lottery. (Renunciaría - would)
If we ____ the price, they would buy. (Si bajáramos - reduced)
We ____ fail if we launched now. (Fracasaríamos - would)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la oración hipotética exacta.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If we had more money, we would hire more people.
options: If we had more money, we would hire more people.
If we have more money, we will hire more people.
If we had more money, we hire more people.
If we had money, we would hire people.
questions.correct_answer: If we had more money, we would hire more people.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If I were the CEO, I would change the strategy.
options: If I were the CEO, I would change the strategy.
If I was the CEO, I would change the strategy.
If I am the CEO, I will change the strategy.
If I were the boss, I would change the strategy.
questions.correct_answer: If I were the CEO, I would change the strategy.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If I were you, I wouldn't sign that contract.
options: If I were you, I wouldn't sign that contract.
If I was you, I wouldn't sign that contract.
If I am you, I won't sign that contract.
If I were you, I wouldn't sign the contract.
questions.correct_answer: If I were you, I wouldn't sign that contract.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: What would you do if you were the boss?
options: What would you do if you were the boss?
What will you do if you are the boss?
What would you do if you was the boss?
What would you do if you were the manager?
questions.correct_answer: What would you do if you were the boss?

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If he spoke English, he would get a promotion.
options: If he spoke English, he would get a promotion.
If he speaks English, he will get a promotion.
If he spoke English, he gets a promotion.
If he would speak English, he would get a promotion.
questions.correct_answer: If he spoke English, he would get a promotion.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: They would buy our software if we reduced the price.
options: They would buy our software if we reduced the price.
They will buy our software if we reduce the price.
They would buy the software if we reduced the price.
They would buy our software if we reduce the price.
questions.correct_answer: They would buy our software if we reduced the price.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I would quit my job if I won the lottery.
options: I would quit my job if I won the lottery.
I will quit my job if I win the lottery.
I quit my job if I won the lottery.
I would quit if I won the lottery.
questions.correct_answer: I would quit my job if I won the lottery.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
options: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
If she knows the answer, she will tell us.
If she knew the answer, she tells us.
If she knew, she would tell us.
questions.correct_answer: If she knew the answer, she would tell us.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: We would travel more if we had more vacations.
options: We would travel more if we had more vacations.
We will travel more if we have more vacations.
We would travel more if we have more vacations.
We travel more if we had more vacations.
questions.correct_answer: We would travel more if we had more vacations.

questions.question: Listen carefully.
questions.tts_text: I would accept the offer if they paid me more.
options: I would accept the offer if they paid me more.
I will accept the offer if they pay me more.
I would accept if they paid me more money.
I would accept the offer if they pay me more.
questions.correct_answer: I would accept the offer if they paid me more.
